title: DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs
abstract: arXiv:2608.14614v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets. This paper investigates whether these retired GPUs can find a productive afterlife to form a DumpsterCluster that can serve modern LLM inference, and under what conditions such repurposing is economically viable and environmentally sustainable. We physically built a 128-GPU DumpsterCluster from scratch using only second-hand components and ran it for one year. At current market prices (\$22K for the DumpsterCluster vs. \$600K for an 8-GPU B200 system), the economic advantages are substantial. Through pipeline-parallel optimizations, our V100 based DumpsterCluster achieves competitive LLaMA-70B throughput, validating production viability. translated_title: 垃圾堆集群：从垃圾堆寻宝到在60美元GPU上运行LLaMA-70B
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14614v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：随着AI数据中心淘汰功能正常的GPU，大量仍具计算能力的加速器进入二手市场。本文探讨了这些退役GPU能否拥有富有成效的“第二生命”，形成一个能够服务现代LLM推理的“垃圾堆集群”，以及在何种条件下这种再利用在经济上可行且环境上可持续。我们仅使用二手组件从零开始构建了一个128-GPU的“垃圾堆集群”，并运行了一年。以当前市场价格计算（垃圾堆集群成本为2.2万美元，而8-GPU B200系统为60万美元），经济优势显著。通过流水线并行优化，我们基于V100的垃圾堆集群实现了具有竞争力的LLaMA-70B吞吐量，验证了生产可行性。然而，我们的部署揭示了关键的环境依赖性。较旧的GPU每处理一个token消耗显著更多的能量，使得总拥有成本仅在电价低廉的地区才具有优势。
tldr: 本文通过构建并运行一年的128-GPU二手GPU集群，证明了在特定条件下（如低电价地区），利用废弃硬件构建成本极低的LLM推理集群在经济上可行且性能接近现代系统。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that building a 128-GPU cluster from retired GPUs can be economically viable and achieve competitive LLM inference performance, but only in regions with low electricity costs due to higher energy consumption per token.
